summary: Officers were sent to the 2,100 block of Kentucky Street for a domestic disturbance; a man fled inside the home and was arrested on suspicion of domestic battery and resisting, with a domestic violence restraining order already on file.
Crews were sent to a small brush fire about 12 feet wide on the west side of the Chester Avenue bridge, on the south side of the Kern River.
Officers were sent to Interstate 5 just north of Fort Tejon for debris reported across two lanes.
Medics were sent to an Amazon distribution center for a worker who fell down stairs.

Fire crews were sent to an apartment fire on the 700 block of L Street; the apartment was on fire on arrival, the building was evacuated, crews checked the attic for extension and the assignment was downgraded about 20 minutes later.
Officers were sent to the 7,800 block of Splendor Way for illegal fireworks.
Crews were sent to a report of a fire threatening a building at C Street and 19th Street.
Medics and officers were sent to an overdose where the patient was reported unconscious but breathing.
Officers were sent to an apartment on the 1,300 block of Oregon Street for a domestic disturbance; the person reported was described as under the influence.
Officers and medics were sent to the Dollar Tree at Niles Street and Shalimar Drive for a man down; crews checked the area and found no one.
A pursuit ran eastbound on Highway 58, the car reported in the number 2 and 3 lanes at speeds near 90 mph and then above 100.
Deputies were sent to a domestic disturbance on Big Blue Road, where a man was reported to have threatened to kill a woman.
Crews were sent to an outside fire behind the Little Caesars on the 2,600 block of Calloway Drive.
Officers were sent to a domestic battery call where a woman said her boyfriend battered her; the man was reported to be in a car parked in the garage.
Officers were sent to the 500 block of 18th Street for a domestic disturbance; one person was reported to be under the influence.
Officers were sent to a vacant commercial property where a caller reported the front door was unlocked.
Officers stopped a bicyclist on Mount Vernon Avenue just north of Niles Street.
Fire crews were sent to an apartment on the 700 block of L Street shortly before 2 a.m.
Medics were sent to a home on Bedrock Drive for a boy having a seizure.
Crews were sent to a grass fire on the south side of the Kern River near the bike path, just north of Panorama Drive.
Officers were sent to the 1,500 block of Wells Avenue, across from Linda Vista, after a hang-up call from a woman who was crying; no one answered the door.
Officers were sent to a dairy in Rosedale where about 10 cows were out of a fence and close to the traffic lanes.
Fire crews and medics were sent to a residential fire alarm at an apartment on the 600 block of Hosking Avenue, where medics were also asked for a hemorrhage.
A small pickup and a semi-trailer collided in the parking lot of the Love's Travel Stop on Taft Highway; one patient was reported to have a traumatic injury.
Officers were told a man fled north on Chester Avenue with a caller's gray mountain bike, reportedly with a second person.
Medics were sent to the waiting room of the East Brundage Lane Navigation Center on East Brundage Lane for an outpatient.
Crews were sent to a vehicle fire near the office of a mobile home and storage park on West Ward Avenue in Ridgecrest.
Unconscious 30-year-old male found at Sunnyside Ct.
Rear-end crash on Pacheco Road near the mall.
Traffic collision with minor injuries on Wible Road.
Crash blocks road; driver suspected of intoxication.
Traffic stop on vehicle linked to prior weapon case.
Multi-vehicle collision in Target parking lot.
